## Summary

Full-Stack Developer (M.Tech, Gold Medalist) with 1+ year of experience building and securing production web and mobile systems. Backend owner and driver-app developer on a complete, live ride-hailing platform: built its 406-route NestJS + MongoDB + Redis REST API and the Flutter driver app, integrated the customer app and Next.js admin panel, and deployed it all to production; both apps are on Google Play (10K+ and 1K+ downloads). Strong in REST API design, RBAC, payment gateway integration and measured performance and security work (4.8x faster rendering, 92.6% smaller payloads, OWASP Top 10 testing). Seeking a Full-Stack Software Engineer role.

## What I can do for you

- Take a product from idea to live: Design and build the REST API and database, connect web and mobile front ends to it, and put the whole thing into production - as I did for U-Trav, now on Google Play.
- Build and ship mobile apps: Flutter apps for Android and iOS built from Figma designs, with push notifications, live location, payments, multiple languages and regular Play Store releases.
- Connect a designer's UI to a real backend: Take front ends built by others - web or app - and wire them to live APIs, payments and authentication so they actually work.
- Set up and run your servers: DigitalOcean or AWS servers with Linux, Apache/Nginx, PM2, SSL certificates, domains and DNS, firewall, backups and rollback, with every codebase kept in Git.
- Integrate payments, SMS and third-party services: Razorpay, Stripe and Cashfree with webhook verification, MSG91 OTP SMS and WhatsApp Business, Google Maps, Firebase and the Claude AI API.
- Keep it secure and fast: OWASP Top 10 testing, access control, rate limiting and secrets management, plus measured performance fixes.

Bangalore, India | Jul 2026 - Present

- Own the backend of a production platform, now complete and live - a 406-route NestJS/TypeScript REST API over MongoDB and Redis - and built the Flutter driver app end to end; integrated the customer app and the Next.js admin panel (UI by a teammate) with the live API.

- Built features end to end: Driver Pass subscriptions (Razorpay, Cashfree and Stripe orders activated by payment webhook, admin-managed plans), outstation dispatch, SOS, and an AI support assistant on the Claude API grounded in admin FAQs and the driver's account state.
- Run production on DigitalOcean: deployed the APIs (Apache, PM2), admin panel and utrav.in and 1us.co.in websites (UI by teammates) with SSL, MSG91 SMS and all code in Git.
- Measured performance pass: PDF rendering 2.94 s to 614 ms (4.8x) with a shared headless Chrome pool, admin bookings payload 10,503 to 779 bytes (92.6%) with gzip, deadlines on all 26 outbound HTTP calls, exchange-rate caching with last-known-good fallback, MongoDB pool tuning.
- Hardened API security and auditability: Helmet headers, rate limiting on OTP and login, JWT secret in environment config, an access review of all 406 endpoints, and a staff audit trail with before/after values and CSV export.

## Projects

### U-Trav - Ride-Hailing and Logistics Platform
Freelance contract · 2026 - present | NestJS, TypeScript, MongoDB, Redis, Next.js, Flutter

Complete, live booking platform for rides, parcel delivery, intercity trips, tours and rentals: a rider app, a driver app, an admin panel and a fleet-owner portal on one backend.
- My part: the whole backend API, the complete driver app, and the integration of the rider app and admin panel with the live API (their UI was by a teammate); I also deploy and run all of it on the production server, with every codebase in Git.
- Both apps are live on Google Play: U-Trav Driver (10K+ downloads) and the U-Trav rider app (1K+).
- Driver app: 20+ screens built from Figma, 10 languages, background ride-request alerts. Rider app: backend and integration for live ride tracking, SOS and in-ride destination change.
- Subscription payments through Razorpay, Cashfree and Stripe, activated by payment webhooks; PDF rendering cut from 2.94 s to 614 ms.
- Server and hosting setup: a DigitalOcean droplet with a reserved IP running the APIs, admin panel, fleet portal and websites behind Apache virtual hosts and PM2, with Let's Encrypt HTTPS, domain DNS records, fail2ban and backups moved off-server.
- Messaging and services setup: MSG91 OTP SMS with DLT-approved templates and a WhatsApp Business number connected through MSG91, Firebase push notifications, Razorpay payment keys, MongoDB Atlas and Google Play Console releases.
U-Trav Driver on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.utrav.driver
U-Trav rider app on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.utrav.user

### Tea Stall Online Store
Personal project · 2026 | HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Node.js, Razorpay, Vercel

Redesign of a Bangalore tea retailer's website as a complete online store.
- 13-page responsive storefront: shop, product pages, cart, checkout, and catering and franchise enquiry forms.
- Razorpay checkout through four Node.js serverless functions, with cash on delivery as an option.
- Prices are recalculated on the server, so a tampered request is still charged correctly; payments are verified by HMAC-SHA256 signature, with a webhook as backup.
- A demo mode runs the whole checkout without payment keys.

### NeuroDigiScan - Brain Tumour Detection using Deep Learning
M.Tech project · 2022 - 2024 | Python, TensorFlow, Keras, OpenCV, Tkinter, SQLite

Detects brain tumours in MRI scans with a convolutional neural network.
- CNN in TensorFlow/Keras trained on the Kaggle Brain MRI dataset (253 scans), with data augmentation, dropout and precision/recall tracking.
- OpenCV image pipeline: grayscale preprocessing, threshold segmentation and feature extraction.
- Desktop application (Tkinter + SQLite) for doctors: login, patient registration, MRI upload, detection result and a patient report.
